title: tokens-usage: no Webacy depeg webhook received in 2 days

annotations.summary: tokens-usage: the Webacy depeg webhook has been silent for 2 days
annotations.description: POST /hooks/webacy on the usage service has logged no depeg_webhook_received event in the last 2 days. Real DEPEG_TIER_CHANGE events are rare: Webacy tiers only a handful of Solana stablecoins (USDC/USDT/PYUSD/CASH as of 2026-10) and those sit at `ok` for weeks, so the daily `webacy-webhook-heartbeat` job on the assets worker (Cloud Scheduler `tokens-webacy-webhook-heartbeat-prd`, 06:25 UTC) asks Webacy to deliver a signed synthetic event through the real pipe; that delivery is what normally keeps this quiet. Two missed days therefore mean one of: the heartbeat job failed (`webacy_webhook_heartbeat_failed` in tokens-assets-jobs-prd-us logs, or the worker is missing WEBACY_API_KEY / WEBACY_DEPEG_REFRESH_ENABLED), the subscription is gone or points at the wrong URL (`bun scripts/webacy-webhook-subscribe.ts --list`, then `--deliveries --since <iso>`), or deliveries are rejected on our side (`rejected_signature` rows in webacy_webhook_deliveries = stale WEBACY_WEBHOOK_SECRET). The heartbeat proves the delivery path, not that Webacy still emits real tier changes; `depeg_poll_summary.tier_changes` from the 4-hourly sweep is the cross-check for that, and the sweep keeps reconciling advisories meanwhile at sweep latency instead of seconds.
